changelog:
Initial release of ClawCompany virtual team skill:

- Automates development workflows using AI-powered PM, Developer, and Review agents.
- Supports rapid prototyping, feature implementation, and end-to-end app creation on user request.
- Ensures code quality through automated multi-step PM, coding, and review cycles.
- Provides configurable agent setups and sample implementation workflow.
- Works seamlessly with Chinese language prompts and detailed usage instructions.
summary: ClawCompany is an AI-powered virtual team collaboration system that deploys PM, Developer, and Review agents to automate software development workflows.
